description: This file contains rendering logic for various graphical elements in a drawing application, including shape rendering, image handling, freehand drawing, and element caching.

classes.name: ShapeCache
classes.description: Cache for storing shape representations of elements to optimize rendering.

methods.name: getRenderOpacity
methods.description: Calculates the opacity of an element considering frame opacity, erasure, and global alpha.

methods.name: generateElementCanvas
methods.description: Creates a cached canvas representation of an element for efficient rendering.

methods.name: generateElementWithCanvas
methods.description: Retrieves or generates a cached canvas for an element, considering zoom and theme changes.

methods.name: drawElementFromCanvas
methods.description: Draws a cached element canvas onto the main rendering context, applying transformations.

methods.name: renderSelectionElement
methods.description: Renders a selection rectangle around an element.

methods.name: renderElement
methods.description: Main function to render an element based on its type, utilizing caching and drawing helpers.

methods.name: generateFreeDrawShape
methods.description: Generates a Path2D shape from freehand drawing points.

methods.name: getFreeDrawPath2D
methods.description: Retrieves the Path2D object for a freehand drawing element.

methods.name: getFreeDrawSvgPath
methods.description: Converts freehand points into an SVG path string.

methods.name: getFreedrawOutlineAsSegments
methods.description: Converts freehand points into line segments considering element rotation.

methods.name: getFreedrawOutlinePoints
methods.description: Calculates outline points for freehand drawing with pressure simulation.

methods.name: getSvgPathFromStroke
methods.description: Generates an SVG path string from stroke points with fixed decimal precision.
